cards.title: Outgoing Helmholtz Green representation
cards.latex: G=-iH_0^{(1)}(n k |r-r'|)/4; psi(r')=oint[psi partial_nu G-G partial_nu psi]ds
cards.role: reduce the 2D wave equation to boundary data

checks.detail: The Green function and boundary representation are explicit in the manuscript.
dH0(z)/dz=-H1(z) gives the stated source-normal derivative.

cards.title: Boundary integral matrix and TM matching
cards.role: couple interior and exterior boundary equations

checks.detail: B, C, unknown ordering, and continuity are explicit.
The fixed-normal sign convention is required to pass an analytic circular-cavity resonance check.

cards.title: Constant-element quadrature and diagonal limits
cards.latex: C_ll=-1+kappa_l Delta s_l/(2pi); B_ll=Delta s_l/pi[1-ln(nkDelta s_l/4)+i pi/2-gamma]
cards.role: stable numerical discretization of singular kernels

checks.detail: The two diagonal expressions and Gaussian quadrature recommendation are explicit.
For a straight element kappa=0 and C_ll=-1.

open_questions: The author-private rounded-corner curve and element map are intentionally unclaimed; paper-scale acceptance instead verifies the publication's explicit equivalence class and printed constraints.

cards.title: Plane-wave scattering and optical theorem
cards.role: Fig. 5 cross-section scan and resonance seed

checks.detail: Incident boundary values, scattering amplitude, and optical theorem are explicit.
Angular integration of |f|^2 is compared with the optical-theorem value.

cards.title: Trace-Newton resonance and SVD null vector
cards.role: resonance refinement and shared boundary state for Figs. 6-7

checks.detail: The Newton update, SVD null vector, and field reconstruction are explicit.
The minimum singular value must fall and the reconstructed boundary residual must agree with it.

cards.title: Boundary resolution criterion
cards.role: declare whether a run is smoke, feature, or paper-scale

checks.detail: The paper states b>=4 and uses b=16 for validation.
Both wavelength and element length are measured in units of R.
